subject.title: [Bug]: Sandbox prune does not clean up workspace directory

question: Should this focused prune-workspace leak be fixed with a narrow backend-aware cleanup now, or should it wait for the broader managed sandbox lifecycle work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98766?
rationale: Both paths can solve the user-visible leak, but deleting sandbox workspace directories is a destructive sandbox-state operation and the active lifecycle PR changes the same ownership boundary.

options.title: Land a narrow prune cleanup
options.body: Fix this bug directly by removing only eligible non-shared sandbox-owned workspaces after confirmed runtime removal, with tests for browser, shared, rw, and active-scope safety.

options.title: Fold into lifecycle PR
options.body: Keep this issue open as acceptance criteria for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98766 and close it only after that branch lands with exact-head proof.

options.title: Keep manual until ownership settles
options.body: Do not queue another repair until maintainers resolve the active draft lifecycle branch and the closed unsafe cleanup attempts.

recommendation.title: Land a narrow prune cleanup
recommendation.body: Fix this bug directly by removing only eligible non-shared sandbox-owned workspaces after confirmed runtime removal, with tests for browser, shared, rw, and active-scope safety.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the broader managed sandbox lifecycle path and has the strongest history on the sandbox prune and cleanup boundary.
